name: Mouse jiggler
author: Youhan Wu
description: Omarchy menu bar mouse jiggler. Adds a click-to-toggle mouse icon at the right end of the bar so idle lock, screensaver, and apps stay awake.

barWidget.description: Mouse icon at the right end of the menu bar. Click to toggle a one-pixel pointer nudge.

schema.label: Nudge interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to bump the pointer one pixel and put it back. Default 25.
